kind: fixed trading rule, no learning model
note: Compact public summary of the Leader5 selector research (2026-10-11). Price-only backtest in USD normalized to EUR 10,000; no historical EUR/USD conversion, dividends or taxes; 0.25% cost per stock trade side; execution at the next US close. Research only, no real capital, no investment advice.

rule.universe: 30 largest eligible S&P 500 point-in-time members by 63-session average dollar volume (at least 253 closes)
rule.score: close[t-5] / close[t-252] - 1 (12-month momentum, skip 5 sessions); only positive scores
rule.holdings: top 5 at 20% each; a holding is kept while its rank is 10 or better; empty slots stay in cash
rule.rebalancing: decision at each US close, execution at the next session; a kept holding is only re-traded when its weight leaves 20% +/- 2 percentage points

selection.goal: user goal set before the grid: at least EUR 2,000 per year above URTH on EUR 10,000
selection.criterion: mean yearly excess over URTH of at least EUR 2,000 in BOTH 2017-2021 (Sample) and 2022-2025 (OOS)
selection.variantsExamined: about 4,600: 4 V1 variants, 3 Addendum-1 variants, 4,500 grid configurations, 54 extensions, 31 robustness runs
selection.gridMeetingBothNote: one configuration; the second row is the same rule with idle money in URTH instead of cash
laterChangesJudgedOnBothPeriods: absolute momentum filter (improved the worst 2022-2025 year)
daily instead of weekly decision (removes weekday timing luck)
2 pp rebalancing band (bands of 1, 3 and 5 pp give similar results)
selection.caveat: 2022-2025 informed the choice of the rule, so it is not an independent holdout. Only the paper-trading demo from October 2026 on is fresh evidence.

oos.label: OOS 2022-2025 (validation, also used in rule selection)

2026.label: 2026-01-01 to 2026-07-24, computed after the fact
2026.limitation: uses the current 498-symbol list (survivorship); the rule was fixed in October 2026, so this is not a prospective test

meanExcessDefinition: each calendar year starts at EUR 10,000; excess = (strategy return - URTH return) x EUR 10,000; mean over the calendar years of the period

paperTradingDemo.leader5From: 2026-10-12 (first Leader5 trades; 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-11 ran an earlier model ensemble)
paperTradingDemo.allocationSince: 2026-10-13: at most 5 stocks and at most 70% in stocks (14% each), the rest in an MSCI World ETF; the backtests above use the 100%/cash allocation and were not recomputed for this

limitations: about 4,600 configurations examined; 2022-2025 is not a clean holdout
concentrated (5 names); drawdowns of 34-35% in the backtests
price-only, USD returns normalized to EUR; no dividends, taxes or historical currency conversion
dollar volume is a size proxy
